content.description: Toss Bank is a South Korean internet-only bank and part of the Toss financial super app ecosystem built by Viva Republica. Operating entirely through mobile, it offers deposit and checking accounts, a debit card, high-interest savings, personal loans, and easy money management, integrated with the broader Toss app that millions of Koreans use for payments, transfers, investing, and credit tracking. Toss Bank is known for a simple, design-led experience, transparent terms, and features like interest paid on everyday balances, helping it grow rapidly among younger, digitally native customers. As a fully licensed digital bank, it competes with both traditional Korean banks and rivals such as KakaoBank, using the scale and engagement of the Toss super app to bring modern, mobile-first banking to a national audience.
